      (registry_slug IS NOT NULL AND registry_slug=slug AND registry_unit IS NOT NULL AND legacy_to_registry_factor IS NOT NULL AND legacy_to_registry_factor>0))

  CREATE TABLE public.clinical_ranges (
    slug text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.clinical_catalog_entries(slug),
    population text NOT NULL CHECK(population IN ('general','female_adult','male_adult','pregnancy_t1','pregnancy_t2','pregnancy_t3','postpartum','postmenopausal')),

    kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('lab_reference','amani_context')),
    candidate_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shipping' CHECK(candidate_id ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'), unit text NOT NULL,

    min numeric, max numeric, source text, source_url text, source_date text,
    evidence_grade text NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_grade IN ('A','B','C','expert_opinion','unsourced')),
    review_status text NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('SAFE','NEEDS_CONTEXT','DISPUTED','UNKNOWN')),
    reviewer text, reviewed_at text, version integer NOT NULL CHECK(version>0), notes text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT clinical_ranges_identity UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (slug,population,phase,kind,candidate_id),

    CHECK(source_date IS NULL OR source_date ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'),
    CHECK(reviewed_at IS NULL OR reviewed_at ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'),
    CHECK((evidence_grade='unsourced' AND source IS NULL AND source_url IS NULL AND source_date IS NULL) OR
      (evidence_grade<>'unsourced' AND source IS NOT NULL AND source !~ '^[[:space:]]*$' AND source_date IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK(review_status<>'SAFE' OR (evidence_grade<>'unsourced' AND reviewer IS NOT NULL AND reviewer !~ '^[[:space:]]*$' AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)),

      (candidate_id<>'shipping' AND review_status='DISPUTED'))

  COMMENT ON COLUMN public.clinical_ranges.unit IS 'Endpoints use shipping/client units. Convert using explicit clinical_catalog_entries factor before comparing registry units.';
  COMMENT ON COLUMN public.clinical_ranges.kind IS 'lab_reference transcribes legacy clinical, not a patient laboratory interval. Neither kind implies evidence or optimal eligibility.';
